extracted.intended_audience: local news organizations, journalism leaders, funders, and community stakeholders (Philadelphia and nationwide)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and institutional standards for creating, funding, and sustaining local journalism organizations and ecosystems, with emphasis on digital transformation, equitable community service, and protections for editorial independence. Applies to philanthropic partners, publisher leaders, and news professionals seeking sustainable business models and shared practices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scalable solutions for sustainable local news
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lenfest Institute creates solutions for the next era of local news by investing in sustainable business models at the intersection of local journalism and community in Philadelphia and nationwide.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Focus on solutions that can scale; invest in business models (not just editorial projects) that enable long-term sustainability across communities and publishers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Every community deserves a great news organization
rubrics_metrics.description: Our guiding mission is that every community needs and deserves a great news organization.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use this normative principle to prioritize work: support models and projects that expand access to high-quality local journalism across diverse communities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digital transformation and business solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: We support news organizations as they build digital products and develop solutions-oriented coverage that helps communities flourish.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prioritize investments and training that help publishers build digital products, adopt modern business practices, and produce coverage aimed at community needs and problem-solving.

rubrics_metrics.name: Equitably meet diverse communities' news and information needs
rubrics_metrics.description: Equitably meet the news and information needs of diverse communities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Develop different pathways to sustainability for publishers to ensure they are reflective of — and serve — the communities they’re serving; equity in audience reach and representation is a substantive goal.

rubrics_metrics.name: Create and support national networks and Communities of Practice
rubrics_metrics.description: Create national support networks for news professionals and build Communities of Practice for news professionals to collaborate and share best practices.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lend operating expertise, offer strategic advisory services, and convene practitioners so solutions can be shared and scaled across organizations; collaborative learning is a programmatic priority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use grantmaking, training, and synthesis to disseminate sustainable solutions
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lenfest Institute provides grant funding, runs training programs, and synthesizes best practices to develop and disseminate sustainable solutions for local news providers.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combine direct funding with capacity-building (training) and documentation/synthesis of lessons learned so that successful approaches can be replicated.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support high-quality investigative and accountability reporting
rubrics_metrics.description: In 2019, the Institute launched Spotlight PA to provide high-quality investigative and accountability reporting for the benefit of all Pennsylvanians.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Invest in collaborative, statewide investigative efforts that increase accountability and serve broad public interests as part of a healthy local journalism ecosystem.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protect editorial independence through legal and governance structure
rubrics_metrics.description: Although the Institute technically owns The Inquirer, under the legal structure–and to protect its editorial independence–The Inquirer operates independently under its current management team and its Board of Directors. The Institute owns 9,999 non-voting shares; the charitable Inquirer Trust holds the one voting share.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Design ownership and governance arrangements (non-voting shares, charitable trust holding voting share, separate boards) to preserve editorial independence while enabling philanthropic support; clearly separate operating control from charitable oversight.

rubrics_metrics.name: Transparent fiscal and legal accountability
rubrics_metrics.description: Institute legal structure, tax-exempt status documentation, IRS exemption determination letters, Federal tax treatment guidance, annual Form 990s, audited financial results, and policies (Gift Acceptance Policy, Grantmaking Policy) are provided.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain and publish financial documents, tax-exemption letters, audited results, and formal policies to ensure accountability to donors, grantees, and the public.

rubrics_metrics.name: Catalyze local impact: transparency, connection, and equity in Philadelphia
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lenfest Institute supports a sustainable local journalism ecosystem that can catalyze a more transparent, connected, and equitable Philadelphia by linking residents to their neighbors, to news organizations, and to other information resources.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program choices should aim to increase transparency, strengthen community connections, and advance equity within the local news ecosystem; prioritize interventions that link residents to information that helps them flourish.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide free tools and resources for local journalism leaders
rubrics_metrics.description: The Lenfest Institute provides free tools and resources for local journalism leaders to develop sustainable strategies to serve their communities (e.g., 'Find Your News Solution').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Produce and distribute practical, no-cost resources and toolkits to help newsroom leaders implement sustainable models and product strategies.
